name: app.ainook/solnook
title: SolNook
description: Real-time Solana Pump.fun on-chain X-Ray, Dev <60s exit reputation, and unbiased daily stats.

tools.name: scan_token_xray
tools.description: Return objective Solana Pump.fun X-Ray metrics: Block-0 bundling, Dev <60s exit history, Tweet Snowflake freshness, and quote depth.

tools.name: get_dev_reputation
tools.description: Return historical launch count, <60s dev-sell rate, graduation count, and recent mints for a Solana creator address.

tools.name: get_daily_pump_stats
tools.description: Return 100% unbiased daily Pump.fun statistics (total pools, Non-SOL CreateV2 share, bundling rate, dev <60s dump rate).

date_utc.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; defaults to latest)

tools.name: list_recent_clean_launches
tools.description: List recent Pump.fun launches filtered by objective clean-launch criteria (low S0 bundling, no <60s dev sell).

clean_only.description: Only include clean low-risk launches (default true)
